comments: de0b0a44: ;Sets up the variables used for data entry & starts the loop

ed2bc80e: ;Initializes variables for data entry: DIE = file global root, DIC = file global root, DP = file number, DL = first column position for output, DIEL = DIEL suppresses the ELD (Entity Loader Distribution) for the called DID^DICR utility, DU = disables the DU (Uneditable Data) array. Checks if the DA(-1) node exists and quits if not.
7c592893: ;If the DT node exists, set DE(1) to the 7th piece of the 0 node (external value of the .01 field).
6d217268: ;Kills the %Z variable.
4804636d: ;Writes the field label to the output.
82563f70: ;Exits the current routine.
9fc8c55d: ;Writes the field value and wraps the line if value is longer than 45 characters.

e6738458: ;Checks if the field value is longer than 19 characters, if DV (type of data) is not defined, and if DV is of type free text or key. If all conditions are met, it branches to the RW^DIR2 routine to read/edit the field value.

214c80a3: Checks if the input variable Y is not empty and if the current record being edited is not a new record (DV doesn't contain 'I'). If a record exists in the DE array, it prints '(No Editing)' to indicate that editing is not allowed.

95f1e770: Reads user input into variable X with a timeout specified by DTIME. If the user doesn't respond within the timeout, it sets DTOUT and X to the ASCII unit delimiter character and outputs a bell character.
1ce4c396: Terminates the current execution and returns control to the calling routine.
3dca4c6e: Removes the current record being edited from the DQ array and increments the DQ counter.
6cd2d575: Transfers control to the position specified by the DQ counter.
976d6514: If the DE array contains a record at the current DQ position, it transfers control to the PR label. Otherwise, it executes the W and TR routines.

fa447663: If the user input X is empty, it checks if the DV variable doesn't contain 'R' (indicating the field is required), if DV is empty (indicating no input validation), or if the value of D is less than or equal to 0. If any of these conditions are met, it transfers control to the A label.
28d8e453: If X is a question mark, go to the QuickSource routine.
3d57ce93: If X is '@', call the D routine and go to the Z^DIE2 routine.

19912040: If X is a space, and the DV parameter contains 'd' but not 'P', and the user has a DIE default value stored, set X to that default value. If DV does not contain 'D' or 'S', write the default value.

6a01fc72: Perform any necessary transformations on X, such as calling the DIC('S') routine if defined. If there is an output value, write it (unless suppressed by the DB array). Go to different routines based on the value of DV.
ac4b34f7: If the executable help is defined and passes, quit; otherwise, display the remainder of the prompt.
b2bb69df: If no default value is defined, write the remainder of the prompt and set X to the first part of the prompt.

c71316fe: If the DV parameter contains a 'P', it indicates a Pointer. Set up the DIC array for the Pointer lookup, call the DIC routine, and retrieve the IEN of the selected entry. If the lookup was unsuccessful, quit.
089a09e3: If the DV parameter does not contain an 'N', go to the V label. Otherwise, perform data validation. If the decimal portion of X exceeds 24 characters, kill X and go to the Z label.

a86151cc: ;This section handles the formatting of decimal numbers. It removes any leading zeros, removes a trailing zero if present after the decimal point, and converts a number with a decimal point but no fractional part to an integer.
e11f22b6: Execute X and kill off YS variable
9c01366e: Clear screen and environment variables, set DG(DW) to X if X is defined and not up-arrow, and store X in ^DISV if DV contains 'd'.
9a578c81: If DB(DQ) exists, branch to line label Z^DIE17
afd9a53e: Set X to '?BAD'
6cf50f74: Set DZ to X, execute D subroutine, execute QQ^DIEQ, go to line label B
798be3c6: Set D to DIFLD, set DQ(DQ) to a string concatenating DLB, DV, DU, DW, and the 2nd-last piece of X subroutine
6b446650: If DE(DQ) does not exist, execute O subroutine. If X is not '@', go to line RD. If DV does not contain 'R' and X is '@', go to A. If X is '@', set X to Y and go to N.
362b8ee4: ;Execute any special code for this field/file combination.
a61b01e7: ;If data is a pointer, get pointer details and resolve pointer value.
6b0b89e2: ;If data is a variable pointer, get pointer details and resolve pointer value.
169d9ed5: ;Get Y piece from X string which is delimited by Y
3725537f: Handle existing data or data entry.
254e424f: Check for valid data types.
595b7501: Handle new data entry.
065303b4: Quit if no new data.
d7a2d897: Initialize variables for data entry.
b0983c12: Define field properties for data entry.
7b7bd249: Go to reader input.
ecc88bf3: Get date input from user.
8fbefdb9: Quit after getting date.
29256cbf: Handle data entry validation and storage.
e6a1ac45: Validate date is after DATE DICTATED.
39fa1c77: Exit the routine if the user aborts the input field.
0f936dfd: Process the user's input and call DIE17 to process the field update.
c4a2a121: If the user's input is blank, set DGJTST to 'SIGNED' and Y to '@2' (special FileMan code).
5e5dae8a: Exit the current routine execution.
5d250ecc: If data from a previous jump still exists, re-execute DIE17 field processor, then branch to ^DGJXA16.
